list.title: Releases
list.description: Group page changes — publish, unpublish, archive — and put them live together, now or at a set time. Add pages from the Pages list or a page’s editor.
list.namePlaceholder: New release name, e.g. Spring launch

detail.publishConfirmDescription: {count, plural, one {# change goes} other {# changes go}} live together, in one step. This can’t be undone as a whole.
detail.scheduleHint: Pick a time and the release goes live by itself (checked every minute).
detail.entriesDescription: Each page goes out as it is at publish time — keep editing until then. Add pages from the <link>Pages</link> list.
detail.conflicts: Also in {releases} — whichever goes out last wins.
detail.deleteConfirmDescription: The release is removed. Its pages stay exactly as they are.

addDialog.title: Add to release
addDialog.description: A release applies all its changes at once — when you publish it, or at its scheduled time.

actionOption.publish: {count, plural, one {Publish this page} other {Publish these pages}}
actionOption.unpublish: {count, plural, one {Unpublish this page} other {Unpublish these pages}}
actionOption.archive: {count, plural, one {Archive this page} other {Archive these pages}}

addDialog.added: {count, plural, one {Added # page} other {Added # pages}} — <link>open release</link>
addDialog.addFailed: Could not add to the release
